scope: 512 chosen/rejected response pairs at eight fixed offsets; six chunks train and two chunks test
feature_model: Deterministic signed-hash unigram/bigram linear text policy, 512 dimensions, 256 response tokens

release_gates.C2: Every DPO run lowers its stated objective and at least one trained reference is preference-misaligned on held-out real pairs.
release_gates.C3: At least one DPO trajectory enters U while its objective falls.
release_gates.C4: Mean held-out CPO escape rate exceeds DPO by at least 0.02, mean CPO preference accuracy is not lower, and gamma=0 reproduces DPO bit-for-bit.

limitations: This is a CPU-scaled learned text policy on the paper dataset, not the paper's Llama-3-8B model or AlpacaEval/Arena-Hard benchmark.
